message.content: {"hts_code": "4911.99.6000", "reason": "The signs are printed matter on paper exceeding 0.51 mm in thickness mounted to an MDF board, classifiable as other printed matter printed on paper/paperboard over 0.51 mm thick."}
message.reasoning: This is a classic NY ruling — patriotic printed wall sign, MDF with printed paper. Classified in 4911.99 — printed matter? Actually the ruling classified it in 4421? Let me recall: NY N-thing... The ruling (e.g., NY N271234?) classified similar signs in 4911.99.60? Printed matter on paper over 0.51mm mounted to board — Chapter 49 note... Actually there's a known ruling classifying such wall signs in 4911.99.6000, "Other printed matter... printed on paper over 0.51mm thick"? HTS 4911.99.60: "Other, printed on paper or paperboard having a thickness exceeding 0.51 mm"? Actually subheading 4911.99.60 is "Other: Other: Printed on paper or paperboard having a thickness (per ply) exceeding 0.51 mm". Yes, that's why thickness over 0.51mm matters. So 4911.99.6000.
